Fit DStressR from supplied response estimates and variances

Source: R/model.R
fit_destress_summary.Rd

fit_destress_summary() analyzes data where each reporter-perturbation combination is already summarized by a response estimate and an estimated sampling variance. This is useful for public datasets that release processed promoter activities with uncertainty estimates, but not replicate-level wells. The resulting p-values are summary-level Gaussian approximations rather than replicate-level moderated DStressR tests.

Usage

fit_destress_summary(
  data,
  reporter = "reporter",
  perturbation = "perturbation",
  response = "response",
  response_variance = "response_variance",
  response_se = NULL,
  reference_perturbation,
  global_method = c("weighted_mean", "mean"),
  background_rank = 0,
  background_rank_max = 5,
  background_rank_permutations = 100,
  background_rank_threshold = 0.99,
  background_rank_seed = NULL,
  background_impute = c("column_mean", "global_mean", "zero"),
  adjustment = c("global", "by_reporter", "none")
)

Arguments

data

A data frame with one row per reporter and perturbation.

reporter, perturbation

Columns identifying reporters and perturbations.

response

Numeric response estimate column.

response_variance

Numeric response-variance column. This is the primary uncertainty input.

response_se

Optional response-standard-error column. Used only when response_variance is NULL, in which case it is squared internally.

reference_perturbation

Reference perturbation/condition.

global_method

How to estimate perturbation-level global effects. "weighted_mean" uses inverse-variance weights; "mean" uses equal weights.

background_rank

Non-negative integer or "auto" for permutation-based rank selection.

background_rank_max

Maximum rank considered when background_rank = "auto".

background_rank_permutations

Number of permutations used when background_rank = "auto".

background_rank_threshold

Permutation reference quantile used when background_rank = "auto".

background_rank_seed

Optional random seed used when background_rank = "auto".

background_impute

Method used to fill missing entries of the effect matrix before singular-value decomposition. The default "column_mean" replaces missing entries by the observed mean of the corresponding perturbation column. "global_mean" and "zero" are also available.

adjustment

One of "global", "by_reporter", or "none".

Value

A destress_summary_fit object. Use results() to extract the effect table.
